about_the_game:
Helgnar The Conqueror - A story-driven, third-person role-playing action/RPG video game set in the extraordinary Ruthless Warworld. In the single-player adventure video game, players can expect a detailed, multi-layered, thrilling story with long-lasting double consequences and diverse, dynamic gameplay: bloody throne wars, epically staged conquests of kingdoms, hunting genetically modified monsters, and detective investigations. The toughest choices in your life and a revolutionary new role-playing Realistic Connections mechanics will evoke a full range of emotions and give you unforgettable moments throughout the video game, truly bringing to life the complicated characters and strengthening your relationships with them to an indescribable level.

The Personality Formation mechanics will allow you to shape the personalities of seven key characters, and the Fate Maker mechanics will determine the fates of all characters based on your ambiguous and controversial choices. The Realistic Relationship mechanics will evoke untold emotions from complex romantic relationships, and Fatal Choices will make you experience emotions with every dialog option you choose. The new mechanics will revolutionize action/RPGs and reveal the incredible potential of video games. 

You are Helgnar Berserker, a professional monster slayer and the best warrior in Ruthless Warworld. The consequences of the past throne wars once again force you to take the Conqueror's Path and continue slaying kings for the sake of the beginning of the Age of Change. Kingdoms are drowning in the blood of war between two continents, and you will be the one to shift the entire balance of power. The bloody War for the Imperial Dragon Throne of the Creators will test all your will and lust for absolute power. 

The Conqueror will have to confront the kings of Dreigrim, the indestructible Wardor Empire, the titans of Helseid, the invincible gods of Order and determine the final outcome of every living thing. Thanks to new revolutionary mechanics, the fate of the entire World of War is now in your hands, and you are in charge of the final outcome for all characters and the entire world. Change absolutely everything, or burn this Ruthless Warworld to the ground! 

- Helgnar The Conqueror will be released on PS5, Xbox Series and PC. 

— Hellknights’ core goal is to create a high-quality “Game of the Year” for fans, capable of standing alongside The Witcher 3, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, and Baldur’s Gate 3, and thanks to the new revolutionary mechanics, surpass these masterpieces in many aspects. Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 clearly demonstrated that truly high-quality games can be made even on a minimal budget. Everything depends on smart pre-production, a clear vision from the game designer, the team’s hard work, and sheer willpower.

— The Conqueror is most inspired by The Witcher 3 and God of War — games that from the start set an exceptionally high bar for narrative quality and depth of gameplay.

— The game features a well-balanced combination of brutal conquest-driven action and hunting invincible monsters, an emotional multi-layered narrative, and close relationships with characters. Thanks to innovative mechanics, companions truly come to life before your eyes during the journey and deliver a new, indescribable experience.

— The 4,000-page scenario, including the new mechanics and its own coherent mythology of the “Infinite War of Worlds,” is fully completed.

Welcome to all who have embarked on the Conqueror’s Path. I am Danred Dante Helknight, game director of the indie studio Hellknights. The developers of The Witcher 3, God of War, and DOOM saved my life, and since then I have vowed to dedicate it to creating truly alive characters and extraordinary worlds that can inspire and save others, giving them indescribable emotions. Thanks to them, I discovered my life’s ultimate purpose and have spent six years creating a high-quality video game worthy of the title “Game of the Year.”

As a result of the six-year evolution of the scenario of the role-playing action/RPG video game Helgnar The Conqueror, 4 new revolutionary mechanics of “Realistic Connections" have been created. Well-tuned role-playing mechanics will give players the full range of emotions, bring characters to life to the maximum, revolutionize Action-RPGs, give storytelling video games a second wind, inspire a new generation of developers and demonstrate undiscovered potential. Because of the oversupply of game services, I feared for the future of story-driven video games and created many mechanics vital for the industry.

— REVOLUTIONARY NEW MECHANICS AND KEY FEATURES —

Hi everyone. I am Danred Helknight, and I would like to introduce something new and revolutionary to the gaming industry. While writing a multi-layered, logical and non-cliched complicated story, I have created new Realistic Connections mechanics that will evoke inexpressible emotions and unforgettable moments throughout the role-playing video game, strengthen your bonds with your characters to an unprecedented level and revolutionize role-playing video games.

 - Hellknights Studios offers something completely new to the industry - the Personality Formation mechanics. Throughout the game, you make difficult, ambiguous moral decisions and subtly influence the characters traveling alongside you. Each of the 7 key profound characters goes through their own paths of formation, changing in front of your eyes and it is only up to you to determine who they will become at the end of their brutal path. You will face the toughest choices in your gaming life and you will have to choose what is more important to each of you - the development of your favorite character or the many lives of those around you. 

- Due to the Fate Maker mechanics, from now on the lives of absolutely all characters are only at your fingertips. None of the characters are immune, even the key figures, each of the key characters can die and will die because of your ambiguous actions. Want to fulfill your Doomsday destiny and burn down the Ruthless World of War so that new innocent life can be born from the ashes? Then burn the doomed Warworld to the ground! From now on, everything depends only on you and your ambiguous choices throughout the game. Throughout the emotional and brutal story, you'll shape many fates, save, and kill many ambiguous characters. Depending on your actions, each of these complex personalities may save or kill your most favorite character in the future. You will determine the destinies of all the characters based on your own beliefs and values. 

- Fatal Choices will make you nervous and emotional with every choice of dialog option, because behind every choice you can expect Fatal Death. With every choice, you will absolutely feel emotions, because every choice you make kills someone, changes destinies or shapes personalities. In Warworld, you are always responsible for your words and actions.

- The Realistic Relationship mechanics will give you the unforgettable emotions of a complex romantic relationship and will truly vitalize your partner. To win the hearts of key female characters, you have a long way to go – to hear and listen to living personalities with their own opinions. Actually, during your travels, the companion has been analyzing you based on your ambiguous choices, and will eventually give a verdict on all your actions. It is not you who chooses who to be with, but the characters who come to life in your sight decide if you are worthy of them. The Personality Formation mechanics has merely deepened key romantic lines and strengthened the player's bonds with the characters to an indescribable level. 

The revolutionary Realistic Connections mechanics creates incredible bonds between the player and the characters that come to life in front of his eyes, blur the lines between the game and reality. The characters you love so much will come to life in front of your eyes and make key decisions based on your ambiguous and complex actions taken during your exciting adventures together. The unique mechanics will bring characters to life in a new way, bringing action-RPGs to a whole new level and revealing the incredible potential of role-playing video games. The fate of the entire World of War is now in your hands and the final outcome of all the characters and the world depends only on you. 

- UNIVERSALITY - 

The genius of these universal mechanics is that you can work with them on almost any budget. Nothing is impossible, and the mechanics don't require much. We'll roughly be creating as much content as in The Witcher 3, only the content will be of a better quality and more interesting. Instead of the typical illusion of choice, players will have full control over all characters and the entire Warworld. If developers develop games using the Realistic Connections mechanics, they simply won't be able to create a cliched story or hollow characters. The mechanics will force you to develop a story, bring any character to life to the max, and give players far more quality video games. While all the hired screenwriters were hastily cheating off each other and treading water, I looked into the very essence of role-playing video games and squeezed the most out of them. I also have ideas for other new mechanics, but it requires a different budget and I had to put it on hold for later.

— THE MOST ELABORATE SCRIPT IN THE GAMING INDUSTRY AND VARIED GAMEPLAY — 

- EXTRAORDINARY STORY - 

Players are tired of boring, cliched, and trite stories about revenge, saving loved ones, or chasing artifacts. The gaming industry has incredible undiscovered potential, many advantages over other entertainment industries. It deserves much better stories, and after six years of self-improvement, I am ready to give players something new and extraordinary. Players can expect a truly unconventional movie-like violent and emotional adventure about the incredible Path of the Conqueror that will give you the full emotional range and touch all your heartstrings. 

You will live an extraordinary and full-fledged story of the Conqueror's life, in which you will have to be both protagonist and antagonist at the same time. As you hunt monsters and conquer everything in your path, you will have to answer many difficult questions concerning each of us and our complicated lives in a world of violence and war. You will stand not just against the laws, the system, the kings, the gods and the whole world, but against the very essence of man and try to change the world order in itself. 

Technology and weapons are increasingly evolving and becoming more destructive, but humans are not trying to get better and are still stagnating. They are still waging wars being one step away from destroying themselves. Not a single century in our world has passed without wars, and sometimes it seems that mankind is simply unable to exist without them, but is it really so? Is there no way to change this without dictatorship and people must accept their fate and live in a world of war? Are humans capable of evolving as a species into something better and finally ending all wars in the world? Is mankind without evolution only capable of inevitable self-destruction and extinction?

Each of you will have to find the answers to the questions that have kept bothering us throughout our lives. Does each of us have a definite destiny? Do we mold our own destinies? Do our origins shape us, or does everything depend on our choices and surroundings? What is our life worth in a world with no one caring about each other? The main story is a solid, detailed, and valuable work of art with an important message and interesting ideas that have not yet been explored or revealed. The full incredible potential of video games has been utilized and one of the most elaborate scripts in the gaming industry has been created, based on a multi-layer compelling narrative, with dual unpredictable consequences and revolutionary new mechanics.

- DIVERSE AND DYNAMIC GAMEPLAY - 

Berserker will face palace intrigue and the war of two continents for the Imperial Dragon Throne of Order, the extermination of kings and epically staged conquests of kingdoms, bloody battles of thrones and large-scale sieges of indestructible fortresses, battles with the gods of Order and world organizations, gang wars of Godgrad and the hunt for corrupt politicians, exciting realistic romances and numerous contracts for the extermination of proliferating monsters, taming endangered species of animals and hunting for the heads of the most dangerous creatures of Warworld, creating unique weapons and various sets of armor for every taste, duels with the world's best warriors and much more. 

To fight the God Among Men empire, invulnerable creatures and genetically modified monsters, hybrids and mutants, Berserker has at his disposal a large arsenal of various weapons with its own special deep system, which will gradually be replenished with more and more unique weapons, consumables and skills. Epically staged battles against various types of monsters, titans, and invincible Creators require strategy, quick reactions, and the ability to adapt to the fighting styles of a variety of cunning enemies. The Conqueror offers a dynamic, adrenaline-pumping, brutal and immersive gaming experience full of incredibly violent and epically staged action, an extraordinary emotional story with revolutionary mechanics and catastrophic double consequences that change the destinies of the entire world.

— SYNOPSIS —

After losing absolutely everything and enduring all the torments of the Hell of the Ruthless World of War, Dahnred Helgnar Nightblaze undergoes a path of formation from an innocent teenager to a ruthless Berserker, instilling fear in every living soul. Dahnred gains brotherhood, learns the bloody Path of Berserker, and joins a global organization fighting to secure autonomy for the Wolf Kingdom of Redrock. As a member of the unified Berserker brotherhood, he participates in all the Wars of Thrones, in battles with invincible monsters and gradually becomes the informal leader of the brotherhood of the world's best warriors. 

Over hundreds of wars, he kills politicians, jarls, kings and learns about all their weak points. With the invaluable experience of ten years of throne wars, incredible resources and skills in his hands, Berserker keeps a promise he made to himself on a decisive night and starts exterminating kings for the sake of a better future. Inhuman politicians are not easily disempowered and the temporary alliance of the kings of Dreigrim hits him in the heart. After dwelling between life and death, Dahnred changes his principles, beginning to value his loved ones and his only chance for life. 

But the consequences of the past Throne Wars once again compel Helgnar, the best warrior in Warworld, to take up the Conqueror's Path and continue slaying kings in the name of starting the Age of Change. The kingdoms will choke in the blood of war between two continents, and the Conqueror will be the one to change the entire balance of power. The bloody War for the Imperial Dragon Throne of the Creators will test his will and lust for absolute power.

 — 21 FEATURES — 

— AN EPIC SAGA OF HUMAN DESTINY IN THE RUTHLESS WARWORLD —

— FURIOUS COMBAT SYSTEM —

— THE TOUGHEST CHOICES IN YOUR LIFE AND LONG-LASTING DOUBLE CONSEQUENCES —

— THE MOST ELABORATE SCRIPT IN THE GAMING INDUSTRY —

– MULTI-LAYERED STORYLINE –

— SPIRITUAL SUCCESSOR —

– KEY INSPIRATIONS –

P.S. The remaining 20 features and advantages, unfortunately, could not fit here. In our official communities, you will find much more information about the large-scale game presentation in the style of The Witcher 3, as well as additional materials about the storyline and other key aspects of the project.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features depictions of violence, blood and suicide, and imagery that some players may find disturbing. The game contains revealing outfits and light/stylistic partial nudity.
